node.title: Re^4: Store the outcome of a foreach loop in an array
node.author: perl_5eeker
node.doctext: Here is SSCCE #!/usr/bin/perl use customlib; my $file = 'cr.csv'; my $lines; rdfile($file,\$lines); # Remove comments and blank lines @$lines = grep(!/^\s*#/,@$lines); @$lines = grep(!/^\s*$/,@$lines); @$lines = join "\n", @$lines; my @store; foreach my $line (@$lines) { my @val = split(/\,/,$line); push (@store,$val[2]); } #printf "@store\n"; use Data::Dumper; $Data::Dumper::Useqq=1; print Dumper($lines); And you were right - @$lines with Data::Dumper printed the following output: $VAR1 = [ "c1r1,c2r1,c3r1,c4r1,c5r1\nc1r2,c2r2,c3r2,c4r2,c5r2\nc1r3,c2r3,c3r3,c4r3,c5r3" ];
